1.67 bir HATA DUZELTME surumudur; yeni ozellik, yeni izin, yeni hesap turu, yeni satin alma ve yeni veri toplama YOKTUR.
1) Acilistaki "Kimlik dogrulaniyor" ekrani, sunucu dogrulamasi yanit vermezse sonsuza kadar kalabiliyordu ve kullanicinin cikis yolu yoktu. Artik 20 saniye sonra "Yeniden dene" butonlu ekrana geciliyor.
2) App Attest dogrulamasi, ortak istek katmani uzerinden 401 alirsa kullaniciyi sessizce oturumdan dusurebiliyordu; artik oturumu kapatmayan ayri bir istek yolu kullaniyor.
3) Giris basarisiz oldugunda jenerik mesaj yerine gercek sebep gosteriliyor.
asc_inceleme_notu_en:
Move Log turns recorded GPS rides (motorcycle, bicycle, walking, running) into cinematic satellite route videos.

WHAT CHANGED IN 1.67
This is a BUG-FIX release. No new features, no new permissions, no new account types, no new purchases, no new data collection.
- The launch screen ("Verifying identity") could stay on screen indefinitely if the server validation call never returned, leaving the user with no way out: the retry button only existed in the offline state. A 20-second watchdog now moves the app to that offline screen so the user can retry.
- App Attest verification shared the app's normal request helper, which signs the user out on any HTTP 401. Although attestation is fail-open by design, that shared path could silently log a user out. Attestation now uses a separate request path that never ends the session.
- When sign-in cannot start, the app shows the actual reason instead of a generic "try again" message.

No changes to purchases, subscriptions, or account handling. Existing accounts and sessions are unaffected.
